runtime.note: A single native binary plus the SQLite native lib beside it. The host needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: the daemon is a systemd unit and deploy verifies it through systemctl

system.why: a person signs in against this anchor directly, over TCP

units.note: One unit, unprivileged. It runs as the kgsm service account kgsm-base declares, reads and writes the account store that account owns, and binds an unprivileged port.

secrets.why: every session in the cluster is signed with it, and every member verifies against its public half
secrets.note: Generated once, on a machine that has none, and never shipped by any package. Replacing it invalidates every session that exists.

secrets.why: the shared secret that proves membership of a cluster
secrets.note: Shipped blank. A host that is not part of a cluster leaves it blank, which is a state rather than a misconfiguration.
